item.title: Stanford Farm transitions to “fully on-site” solar power
item.description: The dream of a farm powered by solar 24/7, 365 days a year — which dates back to The Farm’s creation 10 years ago — is finally a reality. Meet the people who brought the idea to life. The post Stanford Farm transitions to “fully on-site” solar power appeared first on The Stanford Daily.

item.title: Jewett Lab ‘ReForm’s the world one molecule at a time
item.description: The Jewett Lab has spent years reimagining biological processes to advance technological progress. Recently, the lab helped develop the ReForm process, a way to transform wasteful carbon into acetyl-CoA, a useful biological building block. The post Jewett Lab ‘ReForm’s the world one molecule at a time appeared first on The Stanford Daily.
